# GitHub Copilot Instructions

Before modifying this project, read **`AGENTS.md`** at the repository root.

`AGENTS.md` is the canonical source of truth for all AI agents working on this repository.

## Core Principles

* Evidence First — no invented metrics or experience
* Human in the Loop — human user is the final authority
* Privacy First — private data never exported without consent
* Local First — work locally whenever possible
* Provider Agnostic — no vendor lock-in
* Full Traceability — every claim traces to evidence
* Incremental Changes — test before refactoring
* Simplicity Before Abstraction — add complexity only when needed
* Durable Documentation — no session notes or temporary status files

## Key Policies

* **Do not create status files** (STATUS.md, SUMMARY.md, etc.)
* **Do not create session documentation**
* **Preserve approved architecture**
* **Update canonical docs only for permanent changes**
* **Remove temporary files after tasks**

## Further Reading

* `AGENTS.md` — canonical agent instructions
* `docs/product/` — product vision, principles, glossary
* `docs/development/repository-policy.md` — repository rules
* `docs/specs/` — approved architecture specifications
* `PROJECT_CONTEXT.md` — project history and current status
